440177.overview: Ozelotl is a shmup for the PICO-8.

448880.overview:
A roguelike action-platformer where you use upgradeable weapons to combo powerful enemies to their doom!

Overcome tough fights, platforming challenges, puzzles, and more in your effort to free the titan who is incarcerated in the shifting prison's depths.

451918.overview:
Welcome to OMEGA ZONE. Shoot baddies, avoid lasers. Collect coins to access the bonus round. The shield gives you a moment safety from enemy fire and allows you to phase through the rotating lasers. Extra lives at 5000 and 12000 points. 

Enjoy this port of Omega Race. Another "let's see if I can make a game in an afternoon" joint.

Kill all enemies to advance to the next level. Use the shield to avoid enemy fire and the rotating lazers. Collect yellow coins for the bonus level.

452710.overview:
Explore a mysterious and exciting dungeon filled with exciting mysteries without ever leaving the same room!

Why would you change rooms when clearly this one has all the danger and excitement and danger that one could possibly need?!

Come to the One Room Dungeon and live the rest of your newly mysterious-and-exciting life there!!! The game was made for Ludum Dare #37.
